# Global parameters
[global]
	bind interfaces only = Yes
	interfaces = lo eth0
	map to guest = Bad User
	server min protocol = NT1
	server role = standalone server
	workgroup = HOME
	idmap config * : backend = tdb


[media]
	comment = Family media
	guest ok = Yes
	path = /srv/media
	read only = No


[private]
	browseable = No
	path = /srv/private
	read only = No
	valid users = alice bob


[docs]
	path = /srv/docs
	valid users = @staff
